thread:
deploy-bot: Heads up — runtime v3.4.2 rolled to hosted at 03:12 UTC. Canary shows a small but consistent error spike for longseq workloads (~0.8%). Autoscaling unaffected.

sasha: :eyes: seeing increased KV cache churn in the logs, looks correlated with seq>6k. collecting traces now.

jamal: I repro locally with the longseq test harness. getting `Segmentation fault` in `kv_cache.cpp` when sequence > 8192. minimal repro attached.

anya: tagging release-manager and infra — do we want to pin runtime back to v3.4.1 for hosted canary while we triage?

release-manager: propose temporary pinback for canary and hold full rollout. canary pin + staged rollback plan. agree? :+1:

nate: if we pin, we should also pin the SDK compatibility flag for the next 24h to avoid automatic upgrades. runbook snippet: ```
# pin runtime on deploybot
/deploy pin runtime@v3.4.1 --scope=canary
# set sdk auto-upgrade false
/api/teams/ops/configs set sdk_auto_upgrade=false --ttl=24h
```

maria: +1. Also add a note to release notes: "Rolling back to v3.4.1 for canary due to long-sequence regression; investigation ongoing."

deploy-bot: Confirmed: pinned runtime@v3.4.1 for hosted-canary. Change window locked for 1h. (action id: PB-2026-09-15-01)

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0915-LSREG. Pager schedule: oncall (jamal) 03:20-07:20 UTC. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/longseq-regression

jamal: quick triage notes: suspect memory allocator interaction with new kv eviction heuristics. adding build with older allocator and run tests.

anya: checklist for unpin/unblock when fixed: 1) unit & longseq e2e pass on canary 2) perf delta <0.1% on p50/p95 3) SDK compatibility smoke test 4) staged rollout to 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m hold windows. I'll draft the checklist in the release doc.

sasha: logging suggestion: increase kv debug for 2 cycles on canary to capture eviction timestamps. I'll flip the flag now.

release-manager: good. action items assigned: jamal (debug builds), sasha (logs), anya (rollback comms + release note), nate (deploybot pin/unpin choreography). Re-evaluate in 30m.

maria: adding a short blurb to the public status page: "We temporarily halted canary rollout of runtime v3.4.2 for a targeted investigation into long-sequence reliability; no customer-facing downtime expected."

nate: when we unpin, use this command to safely lift: ```
/deploy unpin runtime --scope=hosted-canary --condition="e2e:longseq=pass && perf:delta<0.001"
```

deploy-bot: Note: pinned targets are visible in /deploy status --pins. Use that to confirm.

oncall-bot: Reminder: run full regression across dedicated pool after canary unpin. Schedule run queued.

release-manager: thanks all — we reconvene at 03:45 UTC. If anyone finds a critical blocker, post here and escalate to PLG. :lock:

jamal: update 03:33 UTC — reproducer narrowed to allocator interaction, attempting hotfix build.

sasha: logs flipped, capturing extra traces. will push summary when ready.

maria: posted status page blurb and added note to release notes draft.

anya: 03:44 UTC — pre-unpin checklist drafted in the release doc, linking it here: https://internal/release/2026-09-runtime-v3.4.2/checklist

release-manager: closing interim update. keeping pin in place until green checks. thanks everyone.
